title: PURSUE Release 5 - official record index (all 41 records: documents, videos, images, audio)
doc_notes: This document is an official index of 41 UAP-related records released by the Department of War in 2026.

incidents.summary: U.S. Special Operations Forces AC-130 aircrew observed approximately 25 unidentified 'cold orbs' during a training exercise.
incidents.quote: The report describes the UAP as stationary, approximately four feet in diameter, 0-20 feet above the water’s surface.

incidents.summary: U.S. Naval aviator and USS Gyatt radar observed a delta-shaped object moving at high velocity.
incidents.quote: delta-shaped, about the size of a jet fighter

incidents.summary: U.S. Government Special Agent observed slow-moving objects in the western United States.
incidents.quote: The footage features two, slow-moving “black-hot” areas of contrast
